tool_info.accuracy: best aviation-context source when same-airport TAF exists; no numeric CI
tool_info.label: TAF
tool_info.limits: use only for matching airport/terminal area; not every field has a TAF
tool_info.resolution: change groups, not a fixed hourly grid
tool_info.use: Official forecast written for this airport, 24-30 h. Trust it first when the airport has one.
tool_info.what: Official human-edited aviation forecast for a terminal area.

tool_info.accuracy: strong free near-term aviation guidance; categorical probabilities exist in products
tool_info.da: partial: temp exists, pressure usually absent
tool_info.label: Station LAMP
tool_info.limits: coverage is station-dependent; guidance is not human-edited like a TAF
tool_info.spatial: station guidance where the airport exists in LAMP
tool_info.use: Hourly statistical forecast built from the latest observations, to 38 h. Strong for ceiling and visibility in the next few hours.
tool_info.what: MOS (Model Output Statistics) station forecast: model output statistically corrected with observations.

tool_info.accuracy: good official baseline; less aviation-specific than TAF/LAMP
tool_info.da: partial when temp and pressure are populated
tool_info.label: NWS gridpoint
tool_info.limits: not a direct ceiling forecast and may smooth airport-scale effects
tool_info.resolution: gridded forecast periods; easy API access
tool_info.spatial: official NWS gridpoint at airport lat/lon
tool_info.use: Forecaster-edited NWS grid for the airport's location, 7 days. Good for day-by-day planning.
tool_info.what: Official NWS point/grid forecast sampled at the airport lat/lon.

tool_info.accuracy: good short-range wind/detail; deterministic, no native CI in this pull
tool_info.da: yes when model temp + pressure are present
tool_info.label: HRRR
tool_info.limits: single model run; confidence comes from agreement/verification, not built-in spread
tool_info.use: 3 km model rerun every hour, to 18-48 h. The most detail for today and tomorrow.

tool_info.accuracy: best free longer-range blend; native probabilistic products exist, wrapper is deterministic
tool_info.label: NBM
tool_info.limits: blend can smooth sharp local wind or marine-layer ceiling changes
tool_info.resolution: gridded blend; hourly/period values vary by variable
tool_info.use: Blend of many models, to about 11 days. The steadiest single guess for days 2-7.
tool_info.what: NOAA blend of many model and ensemble inputs.

tool_info.accuracy: useful deterministic comparison member; no native CI
tool_info.da: yes when model temp + pressure are present
tool_info.label: NAM 3 km
tool_info.limits: single model run; weaker than a verified blend when used alone
tool_info.use: 3 km model, to 60 h. A second opinion next to HRRR.
tool_info.what: Regional U.S. model used here as a high-res comparison member.

tool_info.accuracy: broad-pattern context; weak for airport marine-layer ceiling
tool_info.da: yes when model temp + pressure are present
tool_info.label: GFS
tool_info.limits: too coarse for many airport-scale wind/ceiling details
tool_info.use: Global, coarser model, to 16 days. Use it for the trend beyond a week.
tool_info.what: Global numerical weather model for broad pattern context.
